definitions.gloss: change; difference; something out of the ordinary
definitions.explanation: The noun of {変|か}わる: a change from the usual or earlier state. It is used almost always with ある or ない, to say whether anything has changed or whether anything is wrong.

examples.japanese: お{変|か}わり⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are you keeping well? (literally: Is there no change?)
There is no change to the plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{変|か}わり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Even if its shape is different, it's still a precious thing.

notes:
Not to be confused with its homophone ⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧ (substitute; instead of), written with a different kanji: {変|か}わり is about changing, ⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧ about replacing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{変|か}わり⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Are you well? — a polite greeting in letters and after a long time apart
- {変|か}わり⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unchanged; as usual; also {変|か}わり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- 〜こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{変|か}わり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it is still the case that ~; that doesn't change the fact that ~
- {変|か}わり⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to get along as usual
